verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a REST API for creating and managing Lambda Cloud instances and per-minute billing granularity, which supports programmatic lifecycle control and pay-per-use billing, and a community-built CLI/MCP server shows agents can launch/manage instances via this API. However, docs never explicitly enumerate stop/restart/terminate endpoints, and a hands-on community report shows Lambda does not distinguish idle vs. running instances and offers no auto-stop, leading to a $583 bill for an instance left running — undercutting the 'pay only for what is running' promise. Missing for 10: explicit documented stop/restart/terminate API operations, and evidence addressing the idle-billing gap raised by users.
